setup.rulesText:
Welcome to TeamFlow — BGL Buy & Sell.

• Open a ticket in #buy-sell to buy or sell BGL.
• Only deal with staff inside your ticket. Never trust anyone who DMs you first.
• Payment is arranged by staff in the ticket. Prices are in #prices.
• Be respectful. Staff decisions are final.
